items.title: Provider runner: gemini-cli.ts -> antigravity-cli.ts (binary agy, drop usage extraction)
items.context: Rename packages/main/src/providers/gemini-cli.ts to antigravity-cli.ts: GEMINI_CLI_BINARY='gemini' -> ANTIGRAVITY_CLI_BINARY='agy'; geminiCliAvailable -> antigravityCliAvailable; runBoundedGeminiProvider -> runBoundedAntigravityProvider (ProviderExecResult.provider='antigravity'). REMOVE extractGeminiUsage/isGeminiUsageObject (agy does not emit usageMetadata) so reportedUsage is never set. Keep stdout/stderr as digest+byte-count only (raw-never-surfaced). Model: best-effort parse the agy --log-file `label="..."` line, else fall back to the requested --model or 'unknown'. Update the dedicated smoke (provider-gemini-smoke.ts -> provider-antigravity-smoke.ts) to probe `agy` availability + bounded spawn capture.

happy.desc: antigravity-cli.ts exists at packages/main/src/providers/antigravity-cli.ts and exports runBoundedAntigravityProvider + antigravityCliAvailable; gemini-cli.ts no longer exists -> confirms file rename completed correctly; WHY: core rename deliverable
ANTIGRAVITY_CLI_BINARY constant equals agy; running antigravityCliAvailable with agy in PATH returns true -> confirms binary name change; WHY: binary identity is the atomic rename target

runBoundedAntigravityProvider returns ProviderExecResult with provider=antigravity and reportedUsage is undefined/absent (never set) -> confirms usage extraction was removed and provider name is correct; WHY: agy does not emit usageMetadata so extraction must not exist

stdout/stderr in ProviderExecResult contain only digest (sha256) + byteCount fields, never raw content -> confirms raw-never-surfaced invariant; WHY: security invariant that raw LLM output is never persisted in result struct
model field is parsed from agy --log-file label= line when present, falls back to requested --model or unknown -> confirms best-effort model extraction; WHY: model attribution for ledger records

edge.desc: agy binary not in PATH: antigravityCliAvailable returns false; runBoundedAntigravityProvider is never invoked -> confirms graceful unavailability; WHY: CI environments may lack agy

agy process exits with non-zero code: ProviderExecResult still has provider=antigravity, reportedUsage absent, exitCode reflects actual code -> confirms error path still records correct provider identity without fabricating usage; WHY: crash resilience

agy stdout contains no usageMetadata JSON (empty or non-JSON output): reportedUsage remains absent, no parse error thrown -> confirms removal of extractGeminiUsage is complete; WHY: ensures no residual extraction code that would throw on missing data

adversarial.desc: grep -rn extractGeminiUsage packages/main/src/ returns zero matches AND grep -rn isGeminiUsageObject packages/main/src/ returns zero matches -> confirms dead code fully removed; WHY: residual usage extraction functions would violate the no-inference invariant

grep -rn gemini-cli packages/main/src/providers/ returns zero matches (no lingering file or import reference to old filename) -> confirms clean rename with no ghost references; WHY: stale imports cause build failures

provider-antigravity-smoke.ts exists and probes agy availability + bounded spawn capture; provider-gemini-smoke.ts does not exist -> confirms smoke test was renamed; WHY: test coverage must track the rename

items.title: Dispatch + provider-name plumbing: gemini -> antigravity, agy --print argv
items.context: In lattice-dispatch.ts rename runGeminiRealLeafDispatch -> runAntigravityRealLeafDispatch and build agy's argv (`--print <prompt>` + `--print-timeout`, and `--dangerously-skip-permissions` if needed for non-interactive tool steps); route --host=gemini -> --host=antigravity (and the availability gate via antigravityCliAvailable). Update BoundedProviderName 'gemini' -> 'antigravity', PROVIDER_BINARY, defaultProviderAvailable, defaultBoundedProviderExecutor, and planned-steps-executor.ts imports (geminiCliAvailable/runBoundedGeminiProvider/GEMINI_CLI_BINARY). recordDispatchFinalForProvider's provider param 'gemini' -> 'antigravity' (writes an unavailable final since antigravity has no reportedUsage).

happy.desc: runAntigravityRealLeafDispatch exists in lattice-dispatch.ts and is invoked when host=antigravity; runGeminiRealLeafDispatch does not exist -> confirms dispatch function rename; WHY: dispatch entry-point is the routing target

--host=antigravity flag routes through normalizeHostRuntime to antigravity and reaches runAntigravityRealLeafDispatch; --host=gemini also resolves to legacy compatibility path (if kept) or is rejected -> confirms routing plumbing; WHY: CLI user-facing flag must work

agy argv includes --print <prompt> and --print-timeout; --dangerously-skip-permissions present when non-interactive -> confirms correct agy CLI argument construction; WHY: agy uses --print mode not --prompt-file
BoundedProviderName type includes antigravity and does NOT include gemini -> confirms type union update; WHY: type-level correctness prevents stale provider references at compile time

PROVIDER_BINARY map has antigravity:agy entry and no gemini entry; defaultProviderAvailable routes antigravity to antigravityCliAvailable; defaultBoundedProviderExecutor routes antigravity to runBoundedAntigravityProvider -> confirms plumbing in planned-steps-executor.ts; WHY: step executor must dispatch to correct provider

recordDispatchFinalForProvider called with provider=antigravity writes a ledger final with provider.name=antigravity and source=unavailable (since no reportedUsage) -> confirms usage recording path; WHY: acceptance signal for ledger correctness

edge.desc: --host=gemini input: system either maps to antigravity with a deprecation warning or rejects with a clear error -> confirms legacy alias handling is explicit, not silently broken; WHY: existing scripts may pass --host=gemini

antigravityCliAvailable returns false: dispatch fails with a clear unavailability message before attempting spawn -> confirms availability gate prevents blind spawn; WHY: meaningful error vs cryptic ENOENT
HostRuntimeId type includes antigravity; gemini is either removed or explicitly marked legacy -> confirms type-level host identity is updated; WHY: type exhaustiveness in switch/if chains

adversarial.desc: grep -n runGeminiRealLeafDispatch packages/main/src/ returns zero matches -> confirms no residual dispatch function under old name; WHY: dead dispatch function would be unreachable code
grep -n runBoundedGeminiProvider packages/main/src/core/ returns zero matches -> confirms no core module imports the old provider runner; WHY: stale import = build break
grep -n geminiCliAvailable packages/main/src/core/ returns zero matches -> confirms no core module references old availability check; WHY: stale availability gate references old binary name

items.title: Delete the Gemini usage adapter + assemble.ts wiring (antigravity usage = unavailable)
items.context: DELETE packages/main/src/core/usage-ledger/adapters/gemini.ts and remove its use in assemble.ts: drop 'gemini' from the ProviderName union and the `case 'gemini'` in adaptUsageFor (keep anthropic/openai). buildProviderRecord is never called for antigravity (no reportedUsage), so no antigravity adapter is needed; antigravity finals go through the source=unavailable path with a clear unavailableReason (e.g. 'antigravity (agy) print mode does not surface per-call token usage'). Remove the adaptGeminiUsage cases from usage-ledger-adapter-smoke.ts. Confirm no other importer of adaptGeminiUsage / adapters/gemini remains.

happy.desc: packages/main/src/core/usage-ledger/adapters/gemini.ts does not exist (deleted) -> confirms adapter file removal; WHY: gemini adapter is dead code since antigravity has no reportedUsage
assemble.ts ProviderName union does NOT include gemini (only anthropic | openai remain); no case gemini in adaptUsageFor switch -> confirms wiring removal; WHY: no adapter to route to

antigravity dispatch final has source=unavailable with unavailableReason containing a clear explanation (e.g. mentions agy print mode does not surface per-call token usage) -> confirms unavailable path is used with honest reason; WHY: acceptance signal + no-inference invariant

buildProviderRecord is never called for antigravity dispatches (no reportedUsage triggers the unavailable path instead) -> confirms no antigravity adapter is needed or invoked; WHY: adapter-less design for providers that genuinely lack usage data
usage-ledger-adapter-smoke.ts has no gemini test cases; existing anthropic and openai adapter cases still pass -> confirms gemini cases removed without collateral damage; WHY: test hygiene

edge.desc: import of adaptGeminiUsage or adapters/gemini anywhere in packages/main/src returns zero grep matches -> confirms no orphaned importers of deleted module; WHY: orphaned import = build failure

assemble.ts adaptUsageFor called with an unknown provider name (neither anthropic nor openai) throws or returns a clear error rather than silently producing empty data -> confirms exhaustive handling; WHY: future providers should fail loudly if they reach the adapter path without an adapter

adversarial.desc: grep -rn adaptGeminiUsage packages/main/src/ returns zero matches -> confirms complete removal of gemini adapter function references; WHY: any remaining reference is either a build break or dead code
grep -rn adapters/gemini packages/main/src/ returns zero matches -> confirms no import path references the deleted file; WHY: module resolution failure at runtime

zero-cross-module-import invariant: usage-ledger modules do NOT import from providers/ or core/lattice-dispatch (and vice versa for adapter internals) -> confirms usage-ledger encapsulation is maintained through the refactor; WHY: architectural boundary

items.title: Rename remaining gemini provider-semantic references + smokes; grep-clean; suite green
items.context: Rename the 'gemini' provider-semantic literals / runtime-probe ids across core (e.g. capabilities.ts, command-policy.ts, dispatch-policy.ts, planner.ts, verdicts.ts, config.ts, types.ts, process-fact-levels.ts, host runtime probe ids) to 'antigravity'. Rename/rework gemini-named smokes (provider-gemini-smoke, usage-ledger-codex-gemini-smoke gemini cases) + package.json scripts + run-all-smokes discovery. Build clean (tsc, no any) and run the full smoke suite green. Acceptance: `grep -rinE '\bgemini\b' packages/main/src` shows no remaining PROVIDER-semantic reference (model-name strings unrelated to the provider, if any, are explicitly justified); an antigravity dispatch writes a provider.name=antigravity / source=unavailable ledger final.

happy.desc: grep -rinE \\bgemini\\b packages/main/src returns zero provider-semantic matches (model-name strings in comments explicitly justified are acceptable) -> confirms grep-clean acceptance signal; WHY: primary acceptance criteria for the story
capabilities.ts host profile uses id=antigravity (not gemini); buildLegacyGeminiProfile is removed or renamed -> confirms capabilities rename; WHY: host identity in capability system
dispatch-policy.ts LEGACY_KNOWN_HOSTS and isKnownHost use antigravity not gemini; policy validation accepts antigravity -> confirms policy rename; WHY: dispatch routing depends on policy host list
planner.ts preferredVerifierProviders includes antigravity not gemini -> confirms planner rename; WHY: planner provider selection
verdicts.ts provider type includes antigravity not gemini -> confirms verdict type rename; WHY: verdict recording correctness
tsc build completes with zero errors (no any, no unused) -> confirms type-level correctness post-rename; WHY: build-clean gate
full smoke suite (run-all-smokes or equivalent) passes green; no smoke references gemini in its filename -> confirms runtime correctness + test rename; WHY: suite-green acceptance signal

package.json smoke scripts reference provider-antigravity-smoke not provider-gemini-smoke; usage-ledger-codex-gemini-smoke renamed to usage-ledger-codex-antigravity-smoke or gemini cases removed -> confirms npm script rename; WHY: CI invocation correctness

edge.desc: grep -rinE \\bgemini\\b packages/main/src matches only in explicitly justified contexts (e.g. a comment explaining legacy compatibility or a model-name string) with each match individually accounted for -> confirms intentional residue is documented; WHY: false-positive prevention in grep-clean check

process-fact-levels.ts and guard-session.ts and authority-client.ts gemini references are updated to antigravity or removed -> confirms no overlooked core files; WHY: these files appeared in initial grep

run-all-smokes discovery logic finds the renamed smoke files (antigravity-smoke) and does not look for gemini-smoke -> confirms discovery mechanism updated; WHY: silent test omission if discovery uses old names

adversarial.desc: an antigravity dispatch end-to-end writes a ledger final with provider.name=antigravity and source=unavailable and a non-empty unavailableReason; no field contains gemini -> confirms full-stack rename in a live dispatch path; WHY: integration-level acceptance combining CHK-001 through CHK-003
no anthropic or codex smoke regresses (all non-antigravity smokes pass unchanged) -> confirms no collateral damage from the rename; WHY: refactor safety

BoundedProviderName and ProviderName unions are exhaustive in all switch/if chains (tsc --noUnusedLocals catches unreachable branches) -> confirms no dead branches or missing cases post-rename; WHY: type exhaustiveness prevents silent fallthrough
